_comment: Section 5 - Connecting to Real AI Client. Merge this 'mcpServers' entry into your existing claude_desktop_config.json (Claude menu -> Settings -> Developer -> Edit Config). Requires 1_website_knowledge_server_master.py to use transport="stdio" (see Option A in that file) instead of the SSE option used for the in-class client demo -- Claude Desktop launches the script itself, it does not connect to a running port.
